Interface IWebSocketManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
WebSocketManager
public interface IWebSocketManager
Registry of active websocket sessions and their session managers, plus the connect/message/close/error callback hooks, mirroring ballworld.viewModel.web.IWebSocketManager.
